lines: Maintains 2026 Non-GAAP Operating Earnings Guidance of $4.28—$4.40 Per Share

Our financial results for the third quarter and year-to-date period align with our expectations for the full-year, and we are reaffirming PSEG’s 2026 guidance for non-GAAP Operating Earnings in the range of $4.28 to $4.40 per share,” said Ralph LaRossa, chair, president and CEO of PSEG.
